title: Asymptotic influence growth
statement: As $m$ tends to infinity through the natural numbers, the total influence of the composed majority function is asymptotic in order to $\sqrt{2m+3}$; that is, it is bounded above and below by positive constant multiples of this quantity for all sufficiently large $m$.
